description: The Half Moon Bay shoreline south of the Pillar Point Harbor breakwater, 1961 to 2025, on a one-line shoreline model: today's coast as transects, the ERA5-Ocean waves of the cell over the bay hour by hour, the headland and the breakwater as shadows with diffraction, the CERC transport, the bluff where the beach runs out, and two fitted numbers, the transport coefficient and the share of sand passing the breakwater's root that goes through its voids into the harbor. Read against the Corps' and Griggs's rates. Not a fluid dynamics model, and the page says so. Anselm asked for it on 2026-11-08: a separate sim for the Half Moon Bay dredging issue; the Army Corps built sea walls back in the day and they are eroding the coastline and filling the harbor with silt; this is a hard one.

The planet core (observed emissions into a carbon ledger, impulse-response sinks, methane and N2O, a two-layer energy balance, thermal sea level) with countries on top: people per country from the UN, each country's temperature from its own record scaled by the run's warming, the people living outside the human climate niche, and the tipping elements' thresholds checked against the warming. Variants: the hindcast to 2025; emissions held at the 2024 rate to 2100; emissions to zero by 2050. Each is an assumption, never a forecast.

cover_caption: The modelled area seven days after the earthquake in the base run, in the three-dimensional view: the relief, the Willamette and the Columbia, the main roads, and in red the damage, the closed bridges and the closed emergency routes. A still from the runs of 14 November 2026.
description: A magnitude 9 earthquake on the Cascadia subduction zone as it affects Portland, Oregon, set at 2 PM PST on Monday 1 February 2027 as a scenario choice and not a prediction. Each run covers the calendar year 2027, from a month before the earthquake to eleven months after it. Buildings, fuel tanks, bridges, transmission structures and road segments are damaged on the state geology agency's published ground shaking, with saturated soil and daytime occupancy, and the run then tracks electricity, hospitals, fuel and deaths day by day. This is an early model: several results disagree with the studies they are checked against, and many parameters are recalled from memory or guessed.
name: portland-cascadia
title: Portland after Cascadia
